verses.en: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.pt: Disse o Senhor ao meu Senhor: Assenta-te à minha direita, até que eu ponha os teus inimigos por escabelo dos teus pés.
verses.en_web: Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David.> The Lord said to my lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put all those who are against you under your feet.

verses.en: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.pt: O Senhor enviará de Sião o cetro do teu poder. Domina no meio dos teus inimigos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will send out the rod of your strength from Zion; be king over your haters.

verses.en: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.pt: O teu povo apresentar-se-á voluntariamente no dia do teu poder, em trajes santos; como vindo do próprio seio da alva, será o orvalho da tua mocidade.
verses.en_web: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.
verses.en_bbe: Your people give themselves gladly in the day of your power; like the dew of the morning on the holy mountains is the army of your young men.

verses.en: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.pt: Jurou o Senhor, e não se arrependerá: Tu és sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has made an oath, and will not take it back. You are a priest for ever, after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.en: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.pt: O Senhor, à tua direita, quebrantará reis no dia da sua ira.
verses.en_web: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.en_bbe: In the day of his wrath kings will be wounded by the Lord at your right hand.

verses.en: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.pt: Julgará entre as nações; enchê-las-á de cadáveres; quebrantará os cabeças por toda a terra.
verses.en_web: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
verses.en_bbe: He will be judge among the nations, the valleys will be full of dead bodies; the head over a great country will be wounded by him.

verses.en: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.pt: Pelo caminho beberá da corrente, e prosseguirá de cabeça erguida.
verses.en_web: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
verses.en_bbe: He will take of the stream by the way; so his head will be lifted up.
